component.name: Classi
component.summary: Teacher desk for groups, grades, notes, and checklists

description.p: Classi is a local-first app for teachers. It keeps groups, students, grades, attendance, notes, checklists and material tracking in encrypted libraries that stay on your own device.

ul.li: Plan a weekly timetable and run a lesson from it
Record attendance, homework, material and grades during class
Track grades per category with weighted averages, per school year
Keep notes and checklists for a group or a single student

description.p: Every library is encrypted with a passphrase you choose, and a recovery key is issued when you set one up. Optional backup and restore to your own WebDAV server keeps a library safe and portable between devices; there is no Classi account and no Classi server.

screenshot.caption: The weekly timetable, with lessons that still need planning
Grading systems, school years and library security

description.p: The school year is now the frame the app works in: pick one in the sidebar and groups, the timetable, notes and checklists follow it.

ul.li: School years moved out of Settings into their own section
New libraries start with the current school year and two terms
Marking a student absent no longer clears their homework and material records
Libraries are copied aside before a database upgrade, and checked for damage when opened
